verdict.rationale: Galileo is an observability/evaluation platform, not an agent that executes tasks and consumes external tools. The evidence only shows Galileo exposing its own capabilities via an MCP server for other clients to connect to (docs-4, probe-4) — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Galileo itself can plug in and use external MCP servers' tools. This is a category mismatch for the product type rather than a missing feature.
